title: Howler opt-in sound
promptLanguage: Sound stays off until a labelled control is pressed, and that press is what starts the audio context. The choice is remembered and said so on the control.
notes: Howler is the reference for a small player, and no Howler source is stored. Ambient audio is opt-in.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion starts silent, and sound begins only if the visitor turns it on.
